dimensions.summary: One explicit URL creates a private expiring stage; exact install or discard consumes that identity without exposing stage bytes or paths.
Skill, API, security and Decision owners agree on pure-content bounds, safe projection, digest binding, registry CAS and body-free failure.
PIGE-SKILL-001 and E8.01 record the usable URL slice while broader lifecycle acceptance remains planned without status promotion.
Canonical schemas, five registrar channels and safe Settings states give Development and UI one bounded lifecycle surface.
Existing Skill, API, security, Decision and trace owners bind the slice without a new document or generic package-install framework.

UI must keep URL input and reviewed metadata body/path-free and must not imply install before exact commit.
